notes:
Sourced from the official Aaton Digital "CantarX3 User Manual v.3.211.C7" (Dec 19, 2020), hosted on the manufacturer's dedicated product site cantarx.com. Physical I/O confirmed against both the "Inputs & Outputs locations" section (p.10-12) and the connector-pinout annex (p.137-139).

Not included: the manual documents a BNC connector labeled "SDI (N/A)" and a DVI-D output labeled "DVI out (N/A)" on the rear panel — both are explicitly marked non-functional/not implemented in this manual revision, so they were omitted from the port list rather than graded. Also omitted: 2x SD-HC/SD-XC card slots and 2x internal Li-Ion battery bays (media/battery slots, not cabled I/O), and the WiFi antenna (wireless, not a physical connector).

Several real connectors have no exact match in the allowed connector-id list, so the closest available id was used and flagged in that port's note: 5-pin LEMO timecode socket → xlr5; 3-pin TA3 mini-XLR (AES-42) → xlr3; 25-pin Sub-D/DB25 audio breakouts (Tascam TD-88 standard, both AES3 I/O and analog line out) → vga; 4-pin Hi-Rose DC output → dc-barrel; proprietary 26-pin Mini Delta Ribbon "Option" port → rs232. None of these substitutions carry a real grade, so no grade was set on them.

Dante and Ethernet RJ45 ports are present but the manual does not state a network speed (e.g. 100M/1G), so grade was omitted per instructions rather than assumed.

The Cantar X3 is a shoulder/backpack-mounted portable production sound mixer-recorder (waterproof/dustproof aluminum body), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits was omitted.

ports.name: Mic In 3/4
ports.note: One 5-pin XLR carries two mic channels: pins 1/2/3 = Mic 3, pins 1/4/5 = Mic 4.

ports.name: Mic In 7/8
ports.note: One 5-pin XLR carries two mic channels: pins 1/2/3 = Mic 7, pins 1/4/5 = Mic 8.

ports.name: Line In 1/2
ports.note: One 5-pin XLR carries two line channels: pins 1/2/3 = Line 1, pins 1/4/5 = Line 2.

ports.name: Line In 3/4
ports.note: One 5-pin XLR carries two line channels: pins 1/2/3 = Line 3, pins 1/4/5 = Line 4.

ports.name: AES-42 In 1/2
ports.note: Physical connector is a 3-pin TA3 mini-XLR (not full-size XLR3) - closest listed id used. Carries AES-42 digital mic input; can be switched to AES3.

ports.name: AES-42 In 3/4
ports.note: Physical connector is a 3-pin TA3 mini-XLR (not full-size XLR3) - closest listed id used. Carries AES-42 digital mic input; can be switched to AES3.

ports.name: Timecode I/O
ports.note: Actual connector is a 5-pin LEMO (EGG.1B.305) socket, not an XLR - closest listed id used. Pins: LTC In, LTC Out, ASCII data.

ports.name: AES-3 Digital I/O 1-8
ports.note: Actual connector is a 25-pin Sub-D (DB25) female, Tascam TD-88 pinout, carrying 8 channels (4 pairs) of AES3 I/O. No DB25 id exists in the connector list; VGA (same D-sub family) used as closest match.

ports.name: Analog Line Out 1-8
ports.note: Actual connector is a 25-pin Sub-D (DB25) female, Tascam TD-88 analog pinout, carrying 8 balanced line outputs. No DB25 id exists in the connector list; VGA (same D-sub family) used as closest match.

ports.name: Dante
ports.note: Optional Dante card; gives access to 32 Dante I/O channels. Network speed grade not stated in manual.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Speed grade not stated in manual.

ports.name: DC Out
ports.note: Actual connector is a 4-pin Hi-Rose push-pull connector, not a barrel jack - closest listed id used. Outputs V-Batt, 500mA max, thermal-fuse protected.

ports.name: Headphone/Talkback 3.5mm
ports.note: 4-conductor TRRS mini-jack (Nokia LRGM wiring): stereo headphone output plus external talkback mic input on the same jack.

ports.name: Option Port (Mini Delta Ribbon)
ports.note: Proprietary 26-pin Mini Delta Ribbon (MDR26) connector, not RS232 - closest listed id used. Multi-function: LTC I/O, ASCII data, word-clock I/O, tally, an AES3 stereo pair output (AES 5/6), V-Batt power out, remote power on/off, and Cantarem remote-control link.
